verdict.rationale: Codex documents tasks running in isolated cloud environments, configurable per repository with their own dependencies, tools, variables and setup steps. Locally, the CLI enforces a sandbox with inspectable writable roots and permission controls, and review mode reports findings without modifying the working tree. Together these give a clear way to test work in isolation before applying results or opening a PR. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of separating test data or credentials from production (for example, network or secret isolation guarantees), and independent hands-on corroboration that the sandbox isolation holds in practice.
